dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The spirit of the Qucusaur chick Antu stands quietly on the hillside. Unlike Milray, the Tepetlisaur whelp who's loved by humans and saurian alike, Antu stands utterly alone, detached from both heaven and earth...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (As he was in life, so he remains in death. What might he be thinking? It's time I went and asked him.)
